lead.headline: Oregon logged zero state water-permit inspections in the federal file for 22 months; its warning letters kept arriving
lead.number: 0 Oregon state inspections after 2024-09-30 through July 2026, after 161 in 2023 and 169 in Jan-Sep 2024; its letters kept coming (110 in 2025, 74 in 2026)
lead.watch_out: The warehouse can't tell stopped inspections from a broken state data feed; one call to Oregon DEQ decides it.

Explanation: There were many inspection reports that had the wrong dates in ICIS, and there were a couple of enforcement actions dates that were inconsistent with the dates in the enforcement action in the files. Some facilities had multiple inspections entered into IC IS, and the number in ICIS did not match the inspection reports in the files.
